states: Private mock stack built from this tree (base dcb69cfb02) plus a local-only go build -overlay of internal/mock/generator.go: three standalone Linux agents get SMART rows; Apollo-114 (CPU sensors) and Meridian-731 (SMART only) are stamped as State.ExpireHostTelemetry does (status offline, temperatures kept, collection.temperature unavailable 'host agent stopped reporting', source kept), Europa-405 keeps reporting. /api/resources returned agent.sensors.smart[].collection end to end, status warning and agent.stale true for the silent agents.

Same-session control with the HEAD runtime files under the same Vite: Meridian-731's Temp cell rendered 52°C in threshold green, the tooltip and the drawer Thermals card listed the retained disks as plain current readings, and the guest Physical Disks card showed plain muted 52°C/41°C with no last-known cue.

After: Meridian-731's Temp cell renders '52°C' muted (slate-600 light, slate-400 dark) with a dotted underline, no threshold colour and screen-reader ', last known'; its tooltip lists both disks '(last known)' muted. Apollo-114 keeps its CPU package value (no collection state) while its disk tooltip rows read '(last known)'. Europa-405 is unchanged.

Machine drawer (Platform details > Machine details > Thermals) at desktop and phone: 'Disk nvme0n1 52°C (last known)' and 'Disk sda 41°C (last known)' with title 'Last known reading, not current: host agent stopped reporting'; cpu.package unchanged.

Guest drawer Physical Disks card at desktop and phone: Playwright routes add the agent version a VM-resident agent would carry to analytics-batch-01 and answer its physical_disk child query with Meridian-731's real registry disks (collection state untouched) re-parented to the VM, because mock mode never links an agent inside a VM. Both disks render muted, dotted, with the reason title and ', last known'.

Light and dark schemes on the Machines page. Bundle check: Standalone +0.22 kB, shared chunk +0.20 kB, WorkloadsSurface and InfrastructureWorkspace flat versus a same-machine main build, no tracked chunk renamed.
Not covered: a real host agent going silent on hardware, an agent genuinely running inside a VM, or stale-row CPU/memory/disk cells (flagged separately).
interactions: Enabled the Temp column from View > column picker on /standalone and read every row's cell text, class, computed colour and text decoration.
Hovered the Temp cell of the SMART-only and the CPU-sensor silent agents and read the tooltip rows and their muted state.
Opened the Apollo-114 drawer by row click (desktop) and CPU cell tap (phone), expanded Platform details and the Machine Show details, and read the Thermals rows with their titles.
Opened the analytics-batch-01 guest drawer from the Proxmox guest table at desktop and phone and read the Physical Disks card summaries, data-temperature-reading, titles and decoration.
Swapped the runtime files to HEAD under the running Vite for the same-session control, then restored and re-ran every pass on the final tree.
